content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at service time). This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review, and a medical-necessity appeal has already been filed once without success—necessity isn't the issue, the missing auth is an administrative failure. Resubmission would trigger CO-18, and the balance can't be billed to the patient since this is a provider-side auth failure, not patient responsibility. With no viable recovery path, the correct closure is to write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
